Priya (People Ops): Heads-up: Diego's EAD card was marked delivered by USPS but he says he never received it. Diego, can you confirm tracking and whether you opened a missing-mail request?
Diego M.: Tracking 9400 1111 2222 3333 4444 shows delivered 2025-02-05 to front desk. I checked building concierge and they have nothing. Filed missing mail request with USPS this morning.
Lina K. (Hiring Manager): We were planning Diegoto start 2025-02-10 for shadowing. Is there any way to let him start pending physical card?
Priya (People Ops): Short answer: for payroll/legal verification we need physical EAD or other acceptable proof of authorization (I-797 approval + I-9 docs). Alternatives: A) defer start until card is located/replaced B) remote unpaid onboarding (non-employee) — limited and not recommended C) accept digital receipt + receipt notice for I-9 if Legal approves.
Recruiting - Ops: We have Diego's I-797 approval notice PDF and USCIS receipt notice in the candidate folder. Uploaded just now: https://redwood.share/candidates/diego-m/docs
ImmigrationBot: Per USCIS guidance: for Form I-9, employers may accept an I-797 approval notice along with a receipt for EAD when the EAD is pending replacement; however, HR must follow up with the physical card once available. Electronic copies may be used temporarily. Check local state rules.
Payroll: If we allow start on receipt-only basis, we need signed attestation and copy of documents on file. Payroll will set a contingent hire flag and hold direct deposit until physical card is shown.
Diego M.: I can share the receipt email and create a notarized attestation if that helps. Also willing to pick up replacement EAD at post office if it's misdelivered.
Priya (People Ops): Please do both: upload USPS missing-mail ticket number and the notarized attestation. I'll run it by Legal.
Legal - HR: We can accept I-797 + receipt for a provisional I-9 as long as employer documents the reasonable effort to obtain the physical EAD and sets a 90-day follow-up. We should use our standard "probationary eligibility" wording. I'll paste the template: "Employer relied on document(s) presented on [date]; employee must present original EAD no later than [date]. Failure to present will result in termination"
Lina K. (Hiring Manager): OK — team can do remote shadowing and pair sessions (not customer-facing) until card is resolved. That should help ramp.
Priya (People Ops): Benefits note: benefits eligibility begins on active employee date. If we start Diego under provisional payroll it still counts; Benefits, please confirm any waiting period implications.
Benefits: If payroll marks Diego as active with a hire date, benefits enrollment window starts. If hire is marked contingent/unpaid, enrollment may not open. We need confirmation from People Ops on final hire status.
Priya (People Ops): For minimal risk, we'll set hired status but flag as "pending physical EAD" and mark payroll to hold pay until card presented. Benefits — please allow enrollment once hire is active; we'll instruct Diego he must complete enrollment within 30 days.
Diego M.: Uploaded notarized attestation and USPS ticket: MN-2025-5599. Also requested redelivery and hold for pickup.
ImmigrationBot: Tip: request signature confirmation from USPS and file Form 3833 if suspected theft. Also consider requesting expedited replacement EAD (Form I-765 expedite) only in limited circumstances.
Legal - HR: I'll prepare the provisional I-9 addendum and the termination clause. Priya, confirm the follow-up date (we suggest 90 days from today: 2025-05-06).
Priya (People Ops): Confirmed. I'll set an automated reminder for 2025-05-06 and add a task for payroll to check.
Payroll: Flagged hire as contingent-active, hold direct deposit until EAD seen. We'll run first pay as manual check if EAD presented by next payroll run.
Lina K. (Hiring Manager): Thanks team. Diego, welcome aboard — start time 2025-02-10 remains, but limited to internal work until EAD is verified.
Diego M.: Appreciate it. I'll update if USPS confirms delivery or I pick up the card. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Priya (People Ops): Closing the loop: provisional I-9 addendum drafted, payroll hold set, Benefits notified, reminder scheduled. Re-open thread if USPS updates. :white_check_mark:
